So crimes: "非法制造、出售用于抵扣税款的发票罪" which is "非法制造、出售发票罪" (illegal manufacturing and selling of invoices for tax deduction). Also possibly "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" but examples show they label as "虚开增值税专用发票" for similar. However here they are manufacturing false invoices for tax deduction, not for actual transaction. The label used in earlier examples: For virtual invoices they used "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票;经济犯". For manufacturing and selling they used "非法制造、买卖、运输、邮寄、储存枪支、弹药、爆炸物" etc. For invoice manufacturing they likely use "非法制造、出售非法制造的用于抵扣税款发票罪". In examples, they gave answer "非法制造、买卖、运输、邮寄、储存枪支、弹药、爆炸物" for first case. For invoice case, they might answer "非法制造、出售用于抵扣税款发票罪". Also maybe "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" but not exactly.

Look at earlier example: "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票;经济犯". That was for a company that issued false invoices for tax evasion. Here they are manufacturing and selling false invoices. So the crime is "非法制造、出售用于抵扣税款发票罪". Possibly also "非法制造、出售不能用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款的其他发票罪". So two crimes: illegal manufacturing and selling of invoices for tax deduction, and illegal manufacturing and selling of other invoices. So answer should list both separated by semicolon.

Thus final answer: [罪名]非法制造、出售用于抵扣税款发票罪;非法制造、出售不能用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款的其他发票罪<eoa>
